breakfast.name: Boerewors with Mielie Pap (South African Sausage and Porridge)
breakfast.description: Traditional South African breakfast of creamy maize porridge, grilled farm sausage, and spiced tomato relish - representing heritage and culture of South Africa
instructions: Make pap: Bring water and salt to boil in pot
Slowly whisk in maize meal while stirring continuously to avoid lumps
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent sticking
Stir in butter until melted and combined
Pap should have creamy, smooth consistency
Cook boerewors: Heat grill to medium-high heat or heat oil in large skillet
Place boerewors in coil on grill or in skillet
Cook for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through
Remove from heat and slice if desired
Make sous: Heat oil in pan and sauté onion until soft
Add diced tomatoes and cook until broken down (about 5 minutes)
Serve boerewors and pap together, topped with sous
breakfast.notes: Boerewors means 'farmer's sausage' in Afrikaans and is traditionally cooked on a braai (BBQ). Pap should have creamy consistency, not lumpy
breakfast.fun_fact: This traditional South African breakfast of creamy pap, soft-boiled eggs, and boerewors represents the heritage and culture of South Africa. Often cooked on weekend braais
alternatives: Make with beef stew instead of sausage

dinner.name: South African Boerewors (Traditional Spiced Sausage)
dinner.description: South African farmer's sausage - braai centerpiece
instructions: Mix meat with breadcrumbs and spices
dinner.notes: Never prick casing - juices are essential
dinner.fun_fact: Iconic centerpiece of South African braai
